item_desc5031985.en: Containing the chaotic laws of both heaven and earth, it'll transform into a Heaven Aura or an Earth Aura after balance returns.
item_desc5031985.ch: 蕴含着混乱的天地法则，需要等待一段时间，让其蕴含的天地法则平衡之后，演化成天道之气或地道之气。

item_desc5031996.en:
There is a holy tree called Tiangui (the Heaven's Cassia), and it's been absorbing the powers of the sun and moon for thousands of years. However, it is not the heaven's will for such a magical plant to exist, and the tree is therefore ravaged by storms every ten thousand years. The tree remains standing, though, with only a few of its branches snapped and carried into the mortal world by the wind.
<g>●</g>Obtain by killing the <r>Mythical Beast Lord: Bloodspell Carpia</r> in <g>{#areaName7}</g>.
item_desc5031996.ch:
八荒之中有一株神树，名曰天桂，千万载吸收太阴月华之力，诞生灵智。此等神物天所不容，每过万年便受罡风摧残，然天桂屹立不倒，只是有少许枝干被吹断，随着罡风飘散世间。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>妖兽之王——血魅鲮鱼</r>获得。

item_desc5041015.en: The soul orb of a Evergreen, it's a material for forging Artifacts.
item_desc5041015.ch: 树妖的魂珠，可用于炼制法宝。

item_desc5041025.en: The soul orb of Xingtian, it's a material for forging Artifacts.
item_desc5041025.ch: 刑天残魂的魂珠，可用于炼制法宝。

item_desc5051016.en: Bluey-purplish crystal orb, said to attract souls that have been silenced in the underworld, vanishes when removed from the presence of dark energy. The Soul Lureonly exists in the Fallen Valley. Outside the Fallen Valley, the Soul Lure turns into normal Qi and dissipates into the ether.
item_desc5051016.ch: 青紫色的晶莹宝珠，传说能够用来吸引沉寂于冥界的魂魄，该宝珠一旦脱离冥气萦绕的范围便会消失于无形。 引魂珠只可存在于陨幽谷中。在离开了陨幽谷后，引魂珠便会化作灵气消散在天地间。

item_desc5051017.en:
Special dust that can block the five senses. <r>Ultima Sand</r> can enable a Cultivator to briefly enter certain areas around the Nether Mountains.
<r>Ultima Sand</r> can be purchased in the Market.
item_desc5051017.ch:
能够封闭五感的独特粉尘。在持有<r>绝神砂</r>时，可以使修仙者短暂进入冥山外围某些区域。
<r>绝神砂</r>可在坊市中购买获得。

item_desc5051018.en: Mysterious power from the Nether Mountains, highly attractive to those who subsist on dark energy. While it cannot be directly used, throwing it into the Bloodeye Array of the Fallen Valley will lure out Suanyu, a ferocious beast.
item_desc5051018.ch: 冥山中的神秘气息，对吸食冥气生存之生物有着极大的诱惑力。无法直接使用，可丢入陨幽谷的血瞳之阵来引出八荒凶兽之一的酸与。

item_desc5061016.en: Use to buy Destinies when you recuperate (cleared after you leave Tian Yuan Mountain).
item_desc5061016.ch: 休整时购买仙人气运（离开天元山时清空）

item_desc5061026.en: Use to buy buffs in adventure rooms (cleared after you leave Tian Yuan Mountain).

item_desc5061036.en: Rare material found in Tian Yuan Mountain. Use to level up items at mythological creatures' statues.
item_desc5061036.ch: 天元山中的稀有材料，用于在神兽雕像中提升道具的等级。

item_desc5061046.en: Rare material found in Tian Yuan Mountain. Use to make offerings to the god or increase the bear's power.
item_desc5061046.ch: 天元山中的稀有材料，用于供奉天神或者提升熊的修为。

item_desc5061056.en: Rare material found in Tian Yuan Mountain. Use to increase the Mystic Realm's level.
item_desc5061056.ch: 天元山中的稀有材料，用于在秘境仙灵中提升秘境的等级。

item_desc5081445.en:
A rock from the heavens with five colors. Has lots of different functions.
Cultivators in the Origin Spirit stage, when reaching the Nascent Soul stage via a Breakthrough, may use this treasure to gain excellent stats.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name7}, {#building1001Name8} in the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of Beyond</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081445.ch:
先天之石，五光五色，妙用无穷。
具灵境的修仙者在突破至元婴境时，辅以此天材地宝，可以大幅提升修仙者的属性。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name7}、{#building1001Name8}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>无极之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081455.en:
A herb full of qi. Greatly benefits all humans who eat it.
<g>●</g>Obtain by slaying <r>Lord of Beasts: Lonely Cloud Leonid</r> in the <g>{#areaName7}</g> area.
item_desc5081455.ch:
一种灵气盎然的芝草，服食对人大有益处。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>妖兽之王——孤云长乘</r>获得。

item_desc5081465.en:
A crimson, sturdy item that is said to originally be the Xuanwu's shell. 
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081465.ch:
色呈赤金，质地坚韧，相传乃是玄武背甲所化。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081475.en:
A gourd that absorbed the essence of the sun and moon. Has a variety of functions. 
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081475.ch:
吸收万载日月精华的宝葫，妙用甚多。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081485.en:
There is a peach tree on Tian Yuan Mountain. After absorbing the essence of the lands and oceans for ten thousand years, it produced but one drop of divine water.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081485.ch:
乃是天元山上的蟠桃树，感万海之精华，聚天地之精气，历万年方才能凝聚出一滴的神水。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081495.en:
Sand that's said to bring good luck. Definitely not your common sand. Conjures mirages to confuse the viewer.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName7}</g> area.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081495.ch:
传说中能给人带来好运的沙子，并非凡沙，同时也具有迷眼乱神之奇效。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081505.en:
Born out of chaos, this plant has twelve leaves and flowers with twenty-four petals. In its seed pod are six lotus seeds, representing thunder, wind, earth, water, fire and wood. They hold the rules of the heavens and secrets of the universe. Only those with a high cultivation level can wield this item.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName7}</g> area.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> to obtain this item.
item_desc5081505.ch:
混沌而出先天而成，有叶十二片，开花二十四瓣，莲蓬中心生六颗莲子，雷，风，土，水，火，木，藴含天地法则，包藏宇宙玄机，无有莫大仙缘，福难消受。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081515.en:
There's a peach tree on the Tian Yuan Mountain, blooming and yielding fruit once every nine thousand years. These azure peaches can lead to immortality if eaten.
<g>●</g>Can be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName7}</g> area.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081515.ch:
天元峰巅之上有一株桃树，九千年一开花九千年一结果，每结九个，果名碧桃，传闻食之便可升仙。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
